title: A new routine after a decisive step

captions.energy: Demanding complete rejection of former routines
captions.emotions: Recognising a different foundation for life

meaning: Domestic renewal offers support when ending the old leads to a clear new foundation instead of becoming an obligation continually to discard the familiar.
text: You can rearrange home through focused action: noticing a need, choosing direction and taking change to a result. The Chariot in the physical position of Muladhara describes movement for two. Death in energy tests your footing through demanding the former way end completely even when some remains useful. Judgement in emotions recognises that shared life needs another foundation. The positions differ: sharp rejection can unsettle you, while clear understanding reveals why change matters and which arrangements give both more usable time at home.

For example, you decide to free weekends from a large household list. At first everything customary seems to need cancelling, then the central need becomes clear: regular rest together. **What now has room reveals the new foundation.** One free morning hour expresses understanding more precisely than abandoning every former custom. Directed action continues an inward turning, and ending the old need not remove every familiar useful detail from home.

The difficulty is treating any preserved rule as insufficiently profound change. Rejection expands while living differently remains no easier. You end things well and notice less of what already needs quiet maintenance. Support strengthens when insight gains a positive practical form without continually proving itself through another cancelled household custom. The new foundation can then become something you actually inhabit together.
